extracted.intended_audience: general readers, film enthusiasts, and researchers seeking encyclopedic information about the film
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia article summarizing production details, synopsis, cast, release, and critical reception for the 2005 comedy film 'Looking for Comedy in the Muslim World.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Box office
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported box office gross for the film (source: Box Office Mojo footnote). Used as a quantitative measure of commercial performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Production budget listed for the film. Used to compare against box office to gauge financial success or failure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Running time
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total runtime of the film. Relevant for programming, distribution, and audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rotten Tomatoes rating and consensus
rubrics_metrics.description: Holds a 43% rating based on 109 reviews. The site's consensus states: "Although the premise seems ripe for laughs, Albert Brooks isn't ruthless or clever enough to pull it off."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregated critic approval percentage and editorial consensus from Rotten Tomatoes, used as a measure of critical reception and broad critical sentiment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metacritic score
rubrics_metrics.description: Weighted average score of 53 out of 100 based on 35 reviews, indicating "mixed or average reviews."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metacritic's weighted average score synthesizes critic reviews into a single numeric indicator of critical reception.
